name: majiayu000/harness
summary: Rust process-control plane for Codex app-server workflows, combining SpecRail route gates, PR readiness gates, human authorization checks, and review gates backed by a required local Codex provider.
evidence: The example configuration sets Codex as the default and preferred agent, uses Codex as the reviewer, and requires the local codex_cli_review provider for configured review gates.
Implements a Rust Codex app-server adapter and ships SpecRail workflow artifacts with deterministic route and PR gate scripts that return allowed, warn, needs_human, or blocked from local evidence.
